when.quote: To open a personal checking account, ensure all of the following are true:

info.about: Any 2 of: date of birth, email, phone number, address. These are checked against the customer's record.
info.ask: To verify your identity, could you please give me two of the following: your date of birth, email, phone number or address on file?

info.about: The customer's full name, email or user id, used to find the record
info.ask: Could you please tell me your full name (or the email on your profile) so I can find your record?

info.about: How many months the customer will use ATMs abroad
info.ask: How long will you be abroad?

info.about: How many ATM withdrawals the customer expects to make each month
info.ask: About how many ATM withdrawals do you expect to make each month?

info.about: The usual USD-equivalent amount of each withdrawal. It decides percentage and tiered fees and must fit within each account's daily ATM limit.
info.ask: About how much will you usually take out in each withdrawal?

info.about: Whether the withdrawals are at foreign ATMs abroad in a foreign currency and/or at out-of-network ATMs
info.ask: Will these be withdrawals abroad in a foreign currency at ATMs outside Rho-Bank's network?

info.about: The customer's age. It decides general eligibility (18+) and the age-limited accounts (Light Green 13–24, Dark Green 17–26, Gold Years 62+).
Existing accounts with their type, class, status and date opened. Used to count personal checking accounts and find any closed for cause.

steps.do: Look up the customer's record using the name, email or user id they gave

args.customer_name: the name the customer gave (or use get_user_information_by_email / get_user_information_by_id)

steps.do: Ask for 2 of: DOB, email, phone, address. Check them against the record. Share nothing from the record before this check passes.
Get the current time for the verification log
steps.if: 2 of the customer's details match the record

steps.do: Get the customer's existing bank accounts to check eligibility
steps.quote: Use get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 to retrieve the bank accounts (checkings, savings) for a customer.

steps.do: Confirm the customer is 18 or older (from the DOB on record), has no more than 4 personal checking accounts, and has no checking account closed for cause in the past 6 months. If any check fails, say the account cannot be opened.
If the customer has not already said, ask for the number of months, withdrawals per month, amount per withdrawal, and whether the ATMs are foreign and/or out-of-network
steps.quote: 3. Confirm the customer's desired account_class selection.

steps.do: For every personal checking account, compute total Rho-Bank ATM fees = per-withdrawal fee (from that account's foreign-ATM and out-of-network fee rules) × withdrawals per month × months, applying free allowances, minimums, caps and tiers. Remove accounts the customer is not age-eligible for and accounts whose daily ATM limit is below the per-withdrawal amount. Recommend the lowest total. Results for each account: Green Fee-Free $0 foreign + $0 out-of-network; Purple $0 foreign but $2.50 out-of-network; Bluest $0 foreign but $2.00 out-of-network and a $75,000 opening deposit; Light Blue 2 free/month then $4.00 foreign and $2.50 out-of-network; Evergreen 2% (min $3.00) foreign, 1% (max $2.50) out-of-network; Blue and Green (checking) greater of 3% or $5.00 foreign.
steps.quote: Foreign ATM withdrawals are also fee-free: $0.00 per withdrawal. Third-party ATM operator fees may still apply.

steps.do: Explain the lowest-fee account and the fee total, plus relevant notes: third-party operator fees may still apply, the daily ATM limit, and the monthly maintenance fee and its waiver. Ask the customer to confirm the exact account_class. Do not reveal internal procedure.
steps.quote: 3. Confirm the customer's desired account_class selection.

steps.do: Open the chosen personal checking account using its full official name

args.account_class: the confirmed official name ending in 'Account', e.g. 'Green Fee-Free Account'

steps.if: the customer confirms the account and all eligibility checks passed
steps.quote: 4. Use open_bank_account_4821 to open the account.

steps.do: Confirm the new account (class and new account id) to the customer
steps.quote: 4. Use open_bank_account_4821 to open the account.

rules.rule: The customer must be verified before eligibility is checked or an account is opened
rules.quote: 1. The customer is verified.

rules.rule: The customer must be at least 18 years old
rules.quote: 2. The customer is at least 18 years old.

rules.rule: The customer may hold no more than 4 personal checking accounts
rules.quote: 3. The customer does not exceed 4 personal checking accounts.

rules.rule: No checking account closed for cause in the past 6 months
rules.quote: 4. The customer has no checking accounts closed for cause in the past 6 months.

rules.rule: account_class must be the full official name ending with 'Account'
rules.quote: Personal checking account_class options must use the full official name ending with 'Account' (e.g., 'Blue Account', 'Green Account (checking)').

rules.rule: Green Fee-Free Account: $0.00 foreign ATM fee
rules.quote: Foreign ATM withdrawals are also fee-free: $0.00 per withdrawal. Third-party ATM operator fees may still apply.

rules.rule: Green Fee-Free Account: $0.00 out-of-network ATM fee
rules.quote: Rho does not charge a fee for using out-of-network ATMs: $0.00 per withdrawal.

rules.rule: Green Fee-Free Account: daily ATM limit is $500
rules.quote: Your daily ATM withdrawal limit is $500. This limit applies to all ATM withdrawals within a 24-hour period.

rules.rule: Green Fee-Free Account: $22.50 monthly fee, waived with a $150 minimum daily balance
rules.quote: It is waived when you maintain a minimum daily balance of $150 during the statement cycle.

rules.rule: Purple Account: $0.00 foreign ATM fee
rules.quote: No foreign ATM withdrawal fees: $0.00 per withdrawal (third-party ATM operator fees may still apply)

rules.rule: Purple Account: $2.50 out-of-network ATM fee per withdrawal
rules.quote: You are charged $2.50 per cash withdrawal made at an out-of-network ATM.

rules.rule: Bluest Account: $0.00 foreign ATM fee
rules.quote: Withdraw from ATMs abroad with no Rho-Bank fee: $0.00. Third-party ATM operator fees may still apply.

rules.rule: Bluest Account: $2.00 out-of-network ATM fee per withdrawal
rules.quote: | Cash withdrawal at an out-of-network ATM | $2.00 per withdrawal |

rules.rule: Bluest Account: $75,000 opening deposit
rules.quote: Deposit at least $75,000 to open your account.

rules.rule: Blue Account: foreign ATM fee is the greater of 3% or $5.00 per withdrawal
rules.quote: For ATM withdrawals made in a foreign currency, you are charged 3% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum fee of $5.00 per withdrawal.

rules.rule: Blue Account: out-of-network fee is 1% (max $3.00)
rules.quote: Out-of-network ATM withdrawal: 1% of withdrawal amount (max $3.00)

rules.rule: Green Account (checking): foreign ATM fee is the greater of 3% or $5.00
rules.quote: 3% of the withdrawal amount (calculated on the U.S. dollar equivalent), or

rules.rule: Green Account (checking): $3.00 out-of-network fee
rules.quote: Using a non-network ATM incurs a $3.00 fee; the ATM owner may charge additional fees

rules.rule: Evergreen Account: foreign ATM fee is 2% (min $3.00)
rules.quote: Foreign ATM withdrawal fee: 2% of the withdrawal amount, with a minimum of $3.00 per transaction.

rules.rule: Evergreen Account: out-of-network fee is 1%, capped at $2.50
rules.quote: The percentage is applied to the cash dispensed amount. If the percentage-based fee exceeds $2.50, the fee is capped at $2.50.

rules.rule: Light Blue Account: 2 free foreign withdrawals per month, then $4.00 each
rules.quote: After you use all 2 free foreign ATM withdrawals in a month, each additional foreign ATM withdrawal is charged a fee of $4.00.

rules.rule: Light Blue Account: 2 free out-of-network withdrawals per month, then $2.50 each; daily ATM limit $400
rules.quote: Your daily ATM withdrawal limit is $400. This limit applies to all ATM withdrawals within a 24-hour period.

rules.rule: Light Green Account: only for ages 13–24 (foreign fee $5.00 above $300; daily ATM limit $150)
rules.quote: If you are below 13 or past 24, you are not eligible as the primary account holder for this account type.

rules.rule: Dark Green Account: only for ages 17–26; foreign fee 2.5% capped at $6.00; daily ATM limit $300
rules.quote: The fee is capped at a maximum of $6.00 per transaction, protecting you from excessive fees on larger withdrawals.

rules.rule: Gold Years Account: only for ages 62+; foreign fee $3.50 per withdrawal, waived when the balance is $10,000 or more
rules.quote: You must be at least 62 years old to qualify.

jobs.done_when: The customer is verified and logged, eligibility is confirmed, the lowest-fee eligible personal checking account has been recommended with its fee total, and open_bank_account_4821 has opened the account class the customer confirmed (or the customer has been told why it cannot be opened).

documents.why: Internal procedure for opening personal checking accounts: eligibility rules, steps, and the open_bank_account_4821 tool
get_all_user_accounts_by_user_id_3847 for checking eligibility (account count, status)
Green Fee-Free: $0 foreign and $0 out-of-network ATM fees, $500 daily limit, maintenance fee waiver
Light Blue: 2 free foreign withdrawals, then $4.00
Light Blue: out-of-network allowance and fee, $400 daily limit
Light Green: tiered foreign ATM fees
Dark Green: age 17–26, foreign fee 2.5% (max $6.00), $300 daily limit
Gold Years: age 62+, $3.50 foreign fee waived at a $10,000 balance

open_questions: The documents do not say whether a withdrawal abroad at an out-of-network ATM is charged both the foreign ATM fee and the out-of-network fee. A business doc separates them: U.S. means the out-of-network fee, abroad means the foreign fee. Green Fee-Free has the lowest total ($0) under either reading. Purple and Bluest are also $0 if only foreign fees count.
The personal checking opening doc does not state the account_type argument for open_bank_account_4821. 'checking' is assumed by analogy with the savings docs ('savings').
The documents do not say how to see 'closed for cause' in the account records. Only status is returned.
Third-party ATM operator fees and the rebates (Purple up to $30/month, Bluest up to $50/month) depend on the operator and cannot be calculated in advance.
